subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: Should verified inference become a hard prerequisite for completing guided onboarding, replacing the current skip-AI and classic-wizard recovery paths?
rationale: Current main intentionally supports completing setup and adding AI later, so changing this first-run contract requires product intent rather than implementation validation alone.

options.title: Preserve in-product recovery
options.body: Keep skip/classic or add an equivalent setup wizard or Fix path while retaining verified inference as the recommended default.

options.title: Require verified inference
options.body: Adopt the hard gate only with explicit approval and a complete in-product provider setup and recovery flow.

options.title: Split the architecture
options.body: Land restart, handoff, and profile-isolation fixes separately and review inference-first onboarding and runtime contracts in a dedicated PR.

recommendation.title: Preserve in-product recovery
recommendation.body: Keep skip/classic or add an equivalent setup wizard or Fix path while retaining verified inference as the recommended default.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the combined design and own the active PR and linked reports.
